info.name: Bullish Trading Market Maker Protection API
Get Market Marker Protection (MMP) by Trading Account ID

params.name: symbol
params.description: The underlying asset id you filter the configurations against. If symbol is provided, this API will only return the market maker protection configuration for this symbol for this trading account.

items.docs:
Get market maker protection configurations under a trading account id

This endpoint requires [authentication](/rest/authentication#generate-a-jwt-token). To filter by `symbol`, additional parameters are required. For detailed instructions, see the [Filtering Support](/rest/general/filtering) section.

MMP configurations are setup per underlying asset symbol for a specific trading Account. While setting up MMP configurations you can specify `windowTimeInSeconds`, `frozenTimeInSeconds`, `quantityLimit` and `deltaLimit` and use it as best suited.
Please reach out to your relationship manager to understand how to enable MMP for your trading accounts.

- To get updates on the status of your set / reset MMP configs request for an underlying asset symbol over WS, please subscribe to `mmpRequest` TOP
